note: The active six: 1b Felothar, 2c Atraxa, 3o Obuun, 4e Roon, 5o Quintorius, 7e Danitha. Buy selections are the Tuned rung with a card already owned substituted into every slot where Tuned would otherwise have required a purchase — the fastest hundred in each box. Ownership comes from Rob's 2026-08-26 purchase checklist. Alternates from the duplicate-resolution and Salvage passes are filed as Manual options on the slot each one would fill, so nothing swaps without a click. No alt-commander cards are selected in any of the six. Ownership is rebuilt from Rob's On Hand / Ordered spreadsheet of 2026-08-27: 391 cards, 260 with copies in hand and 131 still in the post, 745 copies held against 177 ordered. state.owned is the authority and found/boughtQuantities are derived from it. Basics are a pool, not a per-deck figure -- the box of 80 of each plus the loose ones the sheet counts, so Plains 86, Forest 84, and 82 each of Island, Swamp and Mountain. NOTE: the sheet's loose basics (4 Forest, 2 Island, 2 Mountain, 6 Plains, 2 Swamp) do not match the 11 Plains and 6 Mountains quoted for the Lorehold Spirit precon; the sheet is taken as the count of what is physically on the shelf. Zendikar's Roil and Zetalpa, Primal Dawn are absent from the sheet but kept from the previous record rather than dropped.
